channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Abundant Perch, ‘The Lobster Of Chicago,’ Draw Anglers Near And Far To Old South Works
item.description: With plenty of perch to catch and release or take home and fry, the fishing's good at the former South Chicago steel mill — and anglers hope it will stay that way amid major changes planned for the surrounding land.

item.title: Illinois Child Care, Family Assistance Programs At Risk After Trump Freezes $1 Billion In Aid
item.description: Funds will remain frozen until the Trump administration completes a review and determines that the five targeted states are in compliance with federal requirements, though Gov. JB Pritzker said there has been no evidence of fraud in Illinois.

item.title: Rogers Park’s Candyland House On HGTV’s ‘Ugliest House In America’
item.description: Married couple Joe Bergantino and Ricky Gonzalez have worked for years on restoring a neighborhood gem. Now, they have the chance to get a full renovation.

item.title: Chicago Public Schools Inspector General’s Report Outlines Fraud By District Employees
item.description: Fraud cases outlined in the annual report include a staffer who inflated student enrollment numbers and others involving federal COVID assistance programs.

item.title: 20 Things To Do In Chicago This Weekend: Book Swap, Bears-Packers, Shoegaze Dance Party
item.description: You can also celebrate Founders Day at the Nature Museum, enjoy Family Day at the MCA or play bingo for Edgewater Mutual Aid.

item.title: ‘Cat Squad’ Unites To Find Scribbles The Cat After Uptown Apartment Fire
item.description: A team of dedicated cat searchers is looking for Scribbles, who went missing after her human's apartment caught fire in mid-December.

item.title: T.J. Maxx Plans New Lincoln Park Store
item.description: The retailer signed a long-term lease for space near North and Sheffield, with an opening expected next year.

item.title: Before Feds Killed Minnesota Mom, They Killed A Man And Shot A Woman 5 Times In Chicago
item.description: The killing of a 37-year-old woman in Minneapolis by federal immigration agents mirrors two shootings that happened in Chicago last fall.

item.title: Bears. Packers. Grate Night? Or Does The Pack Still Own Da Bears?
item.description: The Bears and Packers have split their previous two playoff matchups in their storied rivalry.

item.title: Former Mayor Lori Lightfoot Launches ICE Accountability Project To Document Agent Abuses
item.description: Lightfoot's project will collect and vet alleged wrongdoing by federal agents on a new website to eventually help "someone with a grand jury subpoena."
